title: Quality of life after strabismus surgery
summary: The aim of the study presented here is to investigate the health-related quality of life of patients before and after strabismus surgery and to examine which factors could have an influence on this.

interventions.name:
Patients with strabismus.
Patients with strabismus are interviewed before and after the planned strabismus operation using questionnaires. At the same time, the patients' clinical data is recorded.
